name: Night Owls
source:
In 2004, Serenity Scott was a sophomore at Mercer University, studying anthropology and computational science. Investigators say she engaged in frequent online conversations with an unidentified individual that went by the pseudonym "hoot83", whose identity has never been verified. 

Serenity Scott was last seen on October 22nd, 2004. To this day, her whereabouts are unknown. No evidence suggests there was foul play.

[From [url=https://vine-moss-games.itch.io/night-owls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2004年，Serenity Scott是美世大学的二年级学生，学习人类学和计算科学。调查人员称，她经常与一名化名“hoot83”的身份不明的人进行在线对话，该人的身份从未得到证实。

Serenity Scott最后一次出现是在2004年10月22日。直到今天，她的下落仍不明。没有证据表明存在谋杀行为。
